Job Overview

We are hiring this Fall. Come learn in a blend of classroom work, job shadowing, and independent work.    As an Apprentice Roofing Repair Technician, you will learn about: Safety  Roof Replacement  Roof Repairs Ventilation Insulation As a trusted leader in residential and commercial roofing, Bone Dry Roofing takes pride in delivering high-quality craftsmanship, exceptional customer service, and a team-first culture that sets us apart in the industry. In 2023, Bone Dry Roofing was named Roofing Contractor of the year and made the list of the Best Places to Work in Indiana by the Indiana Chambers of Commerce in 2024. We're not a franchise; we're a family-owned and operated business with 19 locations and 550+ employees. 

Duties and Responsibilities

Your primary responsibility is to represent Bone Dry Roofing, Inc with the highest degree of professionalism, punctuality, and integrity while providing our customers with respect, honesty, and the highest level of customer service. Complete online trainings and modules as assigned Participate in job shadowings  Participate in station trainings onsite Perform trainings learned through stations and job shadowing Other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Valid driver's license High School diploma Pass a background check and Pre-employment Drug Screen Must be able to lift 50 lbs. Must be able to climb a ladder safely and work at elevated heights on roofs and inspect attics

Compensation & Benefits

Start at $17.50/hour with incremental raises until graduation Medical, vision, and dental insurance available Company paid life insurance Company paid short term disability 401(k) plan  PTO, Vacation, and Holidays paid Company Truck, Fuel and Phone provided for work

By applying for this job, you agree that we can text you (message and data rates may apply).  I consent to receive SMS/text messages regarding my job application with Bone Dry Roofing. These messages may include updates on my application status, interview invitations/reminders, other information directly related to this job application and job opportunities. Message frequency will vary. Message and data rates may apply. (You will have the option to Opt In/Reply Help for help or STOP to Opt Out).
